component.name: Desk Writer
component.summary: Write documents laid out as in Pages
Escreva documentos com a diagramação do Pages

description.p: Desk Writer is the word processor of Desk, an office suite for GNOME that opens the documents of iWork ’09 and lays them out as Pages did, and saves them as OpenDocument text.
O Desk Writer é o processador de texto do Desk, uma suíte de escritório para o GNOME que abre os documentos do iWork ’09, diagrama-os como o Pages fazia e os salva como texto OpenDocument.

Desk Writer is in development. Text, styles, lists, sections, notes, tables of contents, pictures, shapes, text boxes and media are done. Tables, charts, change tracking, templates and printing are still to come.

O Desk Writer está em desenvolvimento. Texto, estilos, listas, seções, notas, sumários, imagens, formas, caixas de texto e mídia estão prontos. Tabelas, gráficos, controle de alterações, modelos e impressão ainda estão por vir.

screenshot.caption: A document with its styles in the format bar

description.p: The third beta, with a window made for GNOME 51:

ul.li: View and Insert menus in the header bar, a format bar with the paragraph and character styles, and the Inspector in a sidebar of compact panes
Find and Replace in a search bar, with Ctrl+H, tabs and line breaks
Keyboard shortcuts that follow GNOME first, with the shortcuts dialog of Libadwaita
A template gallery, recovery of unsaved changes after a crash and a banner for the warnings of a document
The language of the text, the next paragraph style and favorite fonts
Delete Pages deletes the section of the page, and Revert to Style drops the character styles too, as Pages does

description.p: The second beta, with objects and page layout:

ul.li: Pictures, shapes, text boxes, movies and sounds, on the page or in the text, with masks, Instant Alpha, fills, strokes, shadows, reflections and picture frames
Text that wraps around objects, linked text boxes and page layout documents
Formatted text and pictures pasted from other programs
Desk Neue, a font with the widths of Helvetica Neue, so that lines break where Pages breaks them
Fonts with the widths of those of the Pages templates, such as Gill Sans, Optima, Futura and Baskerville
Text copied to other programs with its formatting
Documents saved as an outline print as their outline
Alignment guides, autocorrection and style commands that work as in Pages

description.p: The first beta, for long documents of text:

ul.li: Spelling and grammar, hyphenation, and find and replace
Sections, columns, headers and footers, footnotes and endnotes, tables of contents, links and bookmarks

description.p: The first nightly build: open documents of Pages ’09 and OpenDocument text, edit and format their text, and save them as ODT.
